I'll answer as a world-famous discourse analysis PhD and recipient of the Potsdam Discourse Structure Award.

**TL;DR**: The text is a financial news digest with multiple independent stories. Each mini-story is analyzed separately. The main connective tissue is a global List relation grouping the independent pieces.

### Block 1: Program trading (1–3)

```
(SN-Concession
  (text 1)
  (NS-Result (text 2) (text 3)))
```

### Block 2: Bear Stearns suspension & counterpoint (4–6)

```
(SN-Circumstance
  (text 4)
  (SN-Concession (text 5) (text 6)))
```

### Global structure

The entire text is a List of the independent news blocks:

```
(NN-List
  (SN-Concession (text 1) (NS-Result (text 2) (text 3)))
  (SN-Circumstance (text 4) (SN-Concession (text 5) (text 6)))
  (NS-E-Elaboration (SN-Purpose (text 7) (text 8)) (text 9))
  (NN-Contrast (NS-Result (text 10) (NS-Reason (text 11) (text 12))) (text 13))
  (NS-Attribution (SN-Concession (text 14) (text 16)) (text 15))
  (NS-Interpretation (NS-E-Elaboration (text 17) (text 18)) (text 19))
  (SN-Concession (SN-Purpose (text 20) (NN-List (text 21) (text 22))) (NN-Conjunction (text 23) (text 24)))
  (SN-Concession (SN-Circumstance (text 25) (text 26)) (SN-Attribution (text 27) (text 28)))
  (NS-Result (text 29) (text 30))
  (NS-Elaboration (SN-Purpose (text 31) (text 32)) (SN-Attribution (text 33) (SN-Purpose (text 34) (text 35))))
  (SN-Concession (text 36) (SN-Attribution (text 38) (SN-Attribution (text 39) (text 40))))
  (NS-Interpretation (text 41) (NS-Reason (text 42) (text 43)))
  (text 44)
  (SN-Circumstance (text 45) (SN-Attribution (text 46) (text 47)))
  (text 48)
  (SN-Preparation (text 49)
    (NN-List
      (SN-Preparation (text 50) (NN-List (text 51) (text 52)))
      (SN-Preparation (text 53) (text 54))
      (SN-Preparation (text 55) (text 56))
      (SN-Preparation (text 57) (text 58)))))
```
